mapper.select: SELECT a.bulletin_board_no , a.bulletin_board_id , a.system_code , a.bulletin_board_title , a.bulletin_board_level_seqs , TO_CHAR(a.period_from_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_from_date , TO_CHAR(a.period_to_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_to_date , a.bb_reply_level_depth , a.bulletin_board_parent_id , a.bb_top_post_flag , a.notice_type_code , c.common_code_name AS notice_type_name , a.pop_up_alarm_flag , a.bulletin_board_inquiry_count AS hit_count , a.created_by AS writer_id , NVL(b.full_name_local,b.english_full_name) AS writer_name , TO_CHAR(a.creation_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS wrie_date , CASE WHEN a.attach_file1_id IS NULL AND a.attach_file2_id IS NULL AND a.attach_file3_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END attach_flag FROM LGCOM_BOARD_N a , LGCOM_USER_M_V b , ( SELECT lc.common_code , lcm.common_code_name FROM lgcom_common_code_c lc , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c lcm WHERE lc.code_type_code = lcm.code_type_code AND lc.company_id = lcm.company_id AND lc.inventory_organization_id = lcm.inventory_organization_id AND lc.common_code = lcm.common_code AND lc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_NOTICE_TYPE_CODE' AND lcm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND (apply_start_date IS NULL OR apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (apply_end_date IS NULL OR apply_end_date >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 23:59:59','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AND lc.use_flag = 'Y' ) c WHERE a.system_code = 'LGCOM' AND a.bulletin_board_id = 'LGCOM_NOTICE' AND a.delete_flag = 'N' AND a.created_by = b.application_user_id(+) AND a.notice_type_code = c.common_code(+) AND (a.period_from_date IS NULL OR a.period_from_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (a.period_to_date IS NULL OR a.period_to_date >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 23:59:59','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) START WITH a.bulletin_board_parent_id = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR a.bulletin_board_no = a.bulletin_board_parent_id ORDER SIBLINGS BY a.bulletin_board_parent_id DESC, a.bulletin_board_no DESC

SELECT bn.bulletin_board_no , bn.bulletin_board_id , bn.bulletin_board_title , bn.bb_body_content , TO_CHAR(bn.creation_date,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS creation_date FROM LGCOM_BOARD_N bn WHERE bn.bulletin_board_id IN (SELECT bulletin_board_id FROM LGCOM_BOARD_MASTER_M WHERE system_code = UPPER(#{USER_SESSION.systemCode}) AND bulletin_board_type_code = 'NB' AND bb_use_flag = 'Y') AND bn.system_code = UPPER(#{USER_SESSION.systemCode}) AND bn.delete_flag = 'N' AND bn.pop_up_alarm_flag = 'Y' AND (bn.period_from_date IS NULL OR bn.period_from_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (bn.period_to_date IS NULL OR bn.period_to_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LGCOM_USER_BB_READ_LOG_N WHERE application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND bulletin_board_no = bn.bulletin_board_no) ORDER BY bn.bulletin_board_id, bn.bulletin_board_no DESC
